registration.method: Mean center-offset translation using the right clavicle, scapula, and humerus as BodyParts3D anchors

adaptations.structure: axillary nerve and superior lateral cutaneous nerve of arm
adaptations.method: Feathered radial contraction toward the BodyParts3D humeral axis, limited to the lateral shoulder segment
adaptations.reason: Keep the post-quadrangular-space course close to the surgical neck and deep surface of the deltoid while preserving the medial origin

adaptations.method: Feathered anterior path offsets immediately distal to the cubital tunnel
adaptations.reason: Move the proximal forearm segment between the flexor carpi ulnaris heads and onto the anterior surface of flexor digitorum profundus while preserving the retro-epicondylar segment

adaptations.method: Distal-only path compression with a small palmar depth correction while preserving proximal branch junctions
adaptations.reason: Terminate digital branches within the fingertip pads and keep palmar branches beside the digital vessels rather than beyond the distal phalanges

adaptations.structure: brachial plexus roots, trunks, and divisions
adaptations.method: Posterior depth offset limited to the interscalene and supraclavicular segments
adaptations.reason: Keep the roots and trunks deep to the cervical fascia between the anterior and middle scalene muscles

adaptations.structure: superficial cervical plexus and accessory nerve
adaptations.method: Project-authored tubular paths registered to the BodyParts3D SCM, clavicle, and trapezius landmarks
adaptations.reason: The selected BodyParts3D and Open3DModel upper-limb sources do not contain these structures as separable meshes

adaptations.structure: subclavian, axillary, and terminal cephalic veins
adaptations.method: Viewer-side posterior depth correction restricted to the clavicular segment
adaptations.reason: Prevent the terminal venous junction from projecting through the pectoral surface while retaining the subclavian vein anterior to the anterior scalene
